trailhead.label: Lac des Fées car park above the Saint-Guérin dam, the board’s start

cautions: Working alpages: cows graze around the Cormet d’Arêches in summer and guard dogs may be present; keep your dog on a lead and walk round the herds.
Steady climb of 350 m on mountain paths to about 2,210 m, with steep grassy humps near the cross.
High, open ground: little shade and quick weather changes.
Carry water even though water points are listed.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
